Do racing wheels come with pedals? The Logitech G923, the Thrustmaster T248R and the Moza R3 for Xbox all have pedals in the box. A load-cell brake is the upgrade, about $200. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #simracing #ps5
